question: With every existing DCC-L local structural input kept unchanged, does explicitly learning the nonlinear difference between true ownership and the molecule mean-field reference improve cross-molecule generalization under finite supervision?

official_test.policy: no code path in this round constructs, loads, predicts or scores ad_test.pt or ad_valid.pt; official valid/test are not used for any selection, metric or decision

data.dataset: PyG ZINC subset=True, official train 10000 / valid 1000 / test 1000
data.split_reuse_reason: The frozen Fit8k/Monitor1k/Locked1k partition is the exact split on which the two frozen DCC-L Fit8k trajectories were trained, so the L arm has identical Fit rows, initialisation, batch order and 47400 updates at zero new GPU cost.

model.forward_change: c_loc = local_composer(x_real) - local_composer(x_null), with the same local_composer parameters for both calls; x_null = [b, Wg, Vg, log1p(n_b), bond_feat] and x_real = [b, Wl, Vl, log1p(n_b), bond_feat]
unchanged: atom path a, sum a, sum a^2
initialization RNG order and P3 state loading
model.shared_parameter_rule: two calls to the same local_composer module; two independent networks are forbidden

initialization.p3_seed_rule: torch.manual_seed(seed) -> P3NullModel -> load seed-matched SSL encoder -> p3_state

recipe.data_order: torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed + 101); torch.randperm(8000) at the start of every epoch
recipe.checkpoint_selection: strict minimum Monitor MAE every epoch; ties -> earlier epoch; best_monitor is primary, final is robustness
recipe.standardization: fit_only_norm computed from the 8000 Fit8k rows only; identical function to zinc_dccl_bottleneck_v1

monitor_gates.primary_comparison: delta = MAE(COC) - MAE(L), raw-y MAE, Monitor1k

locked_gates.drop_worst10_definition: top-10 Locked rows by seed-mean frozen L best-monitor absolute error (L s0/s1 average), determined without COC predictions or the delta

bootstrap.note: bootstrap of per-molecule AE differences on the same rows; it does not substitute for independent training seeds

groups.support_key: exact typed radius-2 rooted signature (k2), same construction as the DCC-L bottleneck audit
groups.count_unit: document frequency over the 8000 Fit8k molecules; one molecule contributes at most 1 per signature
groups.fit_self_exclusion: not used for Monitor/Locked evaluation; the support table is built once from Fit8k, no held-out structure enters it
groups.tier_unseen: at least one atom with k2 df == 0
groups.tier_low4: no unseen atom and at least one atom with 1 <= df < 5
groups.penalty: label_excess > 0 from the frozen zema long-cycle audit; used only for evaluation grouping, never for training or selection

difference_representation: per-bond RMS of c_loc and c_abs
within-molecule variance of c_loc across bonds
participation ratio of pooled within-molecule covariance
diagnostics.note: these are diagnostics; a higher participation ratio is not evidence of better performance

no_rescue: do not change the position of the subtraction or use a separate local composer for the null path
do not add parameters, scaling, normalization, attention, gates, losses or structural features
do not change lr, schedule, batch size, update count, warmup, weight decay, clip or dropout
do not add seeds beyond 0 and 1
do not read Locked before a Monitor PASS and freeze
do not read official valid or official test at any point
a negative or near-miss result is recorded and closes the specific hypothesis; it is not converted into another sweep
